WITH filtered_behavior AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
combination_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    translink,
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM filtered_behavior
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
),
totals_per_type AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM combination_counts
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  cc.translink,
  cc.ordertypedist,
  cc.count,
  CAST(cc.count AS FLOAT) / tpt.total_count as fraction
FROM combination_counts cc
JOIN totals_per_type tpt ON cc.ordertypedist = tpt.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
